name: Embedded View
description: Perspective Embedded View component - embeds an entire view inside another with parameter passing support
author: GitWay

path.description: Path to the view file to load (includes navigation icon when populated)

params.description: Parameters to pass to embedded view - names must match target view parameters

useDefaultViewWidth.description: Use default width instead of content-based sizing

useDefaultViewHeight.description: Use default height instead of content-based sizing

loadingOrder.description: Loading strategy: 'with-parent' loads simultaneously (efficient), 'after-parent' loads after parent completes (feels faster)

notes: Embedded View component allows entire views to be reused as templates
Parameter passing enables dynamic content based on context
As of 8.1.4, parameters appear in dropdown for easy selection
Sync Params adds all embedded view parameters and removes non-existent ones
Sync & Reset resets parameter values to their defaults
Parameters can be input, output, or bidirectional (input/output)
Empty state when 'path' property is blank
Cannot modify embedded view contents - displays predetermined view only
Different from containers - embedded views are immutable instances
performanceWarnings: Too many embedded views in single view causes performance issues
Too many nested embedded views degrades performance
Race conditions from parameter passing between views can slow performance
Avoid oversaturating views with embedded components
parameterOperations: Sync Params - synchronizes all parameters with embedded view
Sync & Reset - synchronizes and resets to default values
commonUseCases: Tank views embedded in facility overview
Reusable equipment templates with different parameters
Modular UI components used across multiple screens
